title: allow `go doc` for read-only reviewer roles so a doc-comment finding can be shown with tool output

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261122-035954-42fc, project ork, item S249: `go -C WORKTREE doc ./internal/adjcli Client.Init` was denied with "This command requires approval". A reviewer that wants to show a doc-comment finding with tool output has no allowed way to run `go doc`.

The owner decided on 2026-11-27 (adj 634, `roles.read-only-allowlist-additions`, option all-three) that this slice also covers the two items merged into it from triage. These are S541 (`slicer relay-roles show`, denied during the S261 review) and the rest of S528 (a reviewer cannot run `slicer init --root` in its own temp dir, so it cannot repeat a scratch-project Check line; evidence from S250). The allowlist is in `internal/engine/perm.go:29-41`. The slice adds `go doc` (plain and pinned `go -C`) and `slicer relay-roles show` to the fixed read-only list. It also adds a reviewer-only set of slicer write entries whose `--root` must be the reviewer's own process temp dir. Each addition gets refusal tests for nearby write forms.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-27: adj 634 (go doc, slicer relay-roles show, slicer writes in the temp dir) and adj 639 (slicer init, add, set, note, done and relay-roles, each ending exactly --root TMPDIR).

sections.heading: Failing tests
Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests above and watch each fail for the reason given.
2. In `internal/engine/perm.go`, add `"Bash(go doc*)"` and `"Bash(go -C * doc*)"` after the `go test`/`go vet` entries of `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist`, and `"Bash(slicer relay-roles show*)"` after the `slicer check*` entry. `PinGitC` already pins the `go -C` template, and `CloudUIAllowlist` inherits both. Update the doc comment of `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist` to name them.
3. In `internal/engine/perm.go`, add `ReviewerTempSlicerWrites(tmpDir string) []string`. It returns no entries unless `tmpDir` is absolute, clean and `ShellWord(tmpDir) == tmpDir` (as `PinGitC` requires of the worktree). Otherwise, for each of `init`, `add`, `set`, `note`, `done` and `relay-roles` it returns `"Bash(slicer SUB* --root " + tmpDir + ")"`. The text before `--root` is a wildcard, so `slicer init --root TMP` and `slicer set S1 --field x=y --root TMP` both match, and the entry ends in the literal `--root TMP`, so only the last `--root` can be the temp dir. A longer path, `..` and a trailing argument do not match. Comment it with S527, adj 634 and S510 (the same reviewer-only condition as the temp-dir write grant). Each call returns its own slice.
4. In `internal/daemon/runner.go`, after `writeTMP` is computed, append `engine.ReviewerTempSlicerWrites(req.TMPDir)` to `allowlist` (clone it first) when `writeTMP` is true. Do this before the hook allowlist is built, so a claude-local hook and cloud Claude's `--allowedTools` get the same entries. Do not touch `claude.EditRules`.
5. In `docs/design.md`, extend the Permissions paragraph (`:2726-2750`): the list also allows `go doc` (also with the pinned `go -C`) and `slicer relay-roles show`; a reviewer also gets the fixed slicer writes whose `--root` is its own process temp dir (adj 634).
6. Run `slicer changelog add S527 --text "..."` for `landed-changed/S527.md`. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.
7. Do not add a `Bash(slicer *)` or `Bash(go *)` wildcard, and do not change any other role's list.
